review1.text: A beautiful memory of the Czech Republic!
review1.fullText: A beautiful memory of the Czech Republic! After returning from Prague, I had a sheet made from my own travel photos, and combining it with traditionally hand-engraved Czech stamps is absolutely magical. The package arrived carefully wrapped and without a single scratch. I'll treasure this for the rest of my life.

review2.fullText: A unique souvenir, beautifully made. I was looking for a gift that wouldn't just be another fridge magnet from a souvenir shop, and this was exactly it. The print is sharp down to the smallest detail, the paper feels great, and the online editor was easy to use even for me, though I'd never done anything like it before. I'll definitely recommend it to friends.

review3.text: Brought it home as a gift - everyone loved it!
review3.fullText: Brought it home as a gift - everyone loved it! I ordered several right after returning from Prague, one for each family member, each with different photos. I was worried an order from abroad would be complicated, but the whole process went smoothly and quickly. Now everyone at home has a piece of our shared trip.

review4.fullText: Excellent print quality, fast delivery. I ordered all the way to Japan and the package still arrived in perfect condition within a reasonable time. The colors are vivid, the details sharp, and the packaging was sturdy enough that the sheet survived the trip without a single bent corner.

review5.text: Ordered one for the whole family, everyone loved it.
review5.fullText: Ordered one for the whole family, everyone loved it. Before our family gathering I prepared a personal sheet for everyone with photos from our trip to Prague. It was the hit of the evening - everyone got a unique memory and nobody expected it to look so professional.

q1.question: How long does producing and delivering a Creative Sheet take?
q1.answer: We make a custom Creative Sheet within 1–5 business days of order confirmation and photo upload. Delivery time then depends on the shipping method you choose — usually 1–3 days within the Czech Republic, and varies by destination abroad.

q2.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
q2.answer: You can pay online by card through the payment gateway (both payment and order are confirmed instantly), or by bank transfer — payment instructions are sent by e-mail right after your order is completed.

q3.question: Can I pick up my order in person?
q3.answer: Yes, personal pickup is free at Jindřišská 126/15, Prague 1. As soon as your order is ready for pickup, we'll let you know by e-mail.

cta.title: Didn't find your answer?
cta.text: Write to us and we'll gladly help with anything about your order or production.

s1.title: 1. Operator and Basic Information
s1.content:
The online store at mycreativestamp.com is operated by DVKS s.r.o., Company ID (IČO): 14248328, with its registered office at Nad Studánkou 393, 251 01 Světice, Czech Republic (hereinafter the "Seller").

Contact e-mail: info@mycreativestamp.com

s2.title: 2. Order and Conclusion of the Contract
s2.content:
Orders are placed either through the online editor (Creative Sheet) or by selecting a product in the e-shop and adding it to the cart. By submitting an order, the buyer confirms that they have read and agree to these Terms and Conditions.

The contract is concluded when the Seller sends an order confirmation e-mail. The Seller reserves the right to decline an order in the event of stock unavailability or a technical error.

s3.title: 3. Price and Payment
s3.content:
Prices in the e-shop include VAT. The Seller reserves the right to change prices. The price valid at the moment the order is submitted is binding for the buyer.

Payment is processed via the Stripe payment gateway (payment card). The order is processed once payment has been received.

s4.title: 4. Shipping and Delivery Times
s4.content:
We ship goods to addresses within the Czech Republic and abroad. The standard time to prepare a shipment for dispatch is 1–2 business days from order (payment) confirmation. For personalized products (Creative Sheet), this period is 1–5 business days due to production time.

Shipping is charged according to the current price list shown when choosing a shipping method in the cart.

s5.title: 5. Withdrawal from the Contract
s5.content:
The buyer — as a consumer — has the right to withdraw from the contract without giving a reason within 14 days of receiving the goods, except for custom-made goods (personalized products such as a Creative Sheet with your own photographs), for which the right of withdrawal does not apply under Section 1837(d) of the Czech Civil Code.

Send withdrawal notices by e-mail to info@mycreativestamp.com. Please return the goods undamaged at your own expense.

s6.title: 6. Complaints and Liability for Defects
s6.content:
All goods carry a 24-month warranty period. To file a complaint, please send an e-mail with a photo of the defect and your order number. Complaints will be resolved within 30 days at the latest.

In the case of a justified complaint, you are entitled to a repair, replacement, or refund.

s7.title: 7. Personal Data Protection
s7.content: The processing of personal data is governed by the Privacy Policy available at /ochrana-osobnich-udaju.

s8.title: 8. Final Provisions
s8.content:
These Terms and Conditions are valid from 1 January 2025. The Seller reserves the right to change these terms at any time. Matters not covered by these terms are governed by Act No. 89/2012 Coll., the Civil Code, and Act No. 634/1992 Coll., on Consumer Protection.

Disputes may be resolved out of court through the Czech Trade Inspection Authority (www.coi.cz).

s1.title: 1. Data Controller
s1.content: The controller of your personal data is DVKS s.r.o., Company ID (IČO): 14248328, with its registered office at Nad Studánkou 393, 251 01 Světice, Czech Republic (hereinafter the "Controller"). Contact e-mail: info@mycreativestamp.com.

s2.title: 2. What Data We Process
s2.content:
We only process data necessary to fulfil your order and operate the e-shop:

• Identification and contact details: first name, last name, e-mail address, phone number.
• Delivery address: street, city, postal code, country.
• Payment information: payment transactions are processed directly by the Stripe payment gateway — we do not store card numbers or sensitive payment data.
• Photos and Creative Sheet content: photos you upload while creating a Creative Sheet, and any text you enter. This data is stored solely for the purpose of producing the ordered product.

s3.title: 3. Purpose and Legal Basis of Processing
s3.content:
We process your personal data on the following legal bases:

• Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) — processing your order, producing and delivering goods, customer support.
• Compliance with a legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR) — bookkeeping and tax records for the period required by law (10 years).
• Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) — fraud prevention and technical security.

s4.title: 4. Retention Period
s4.content: Personal data associated with an order is retained for the duration of the contractual relationship and for 3 years thereafter for the purposes of any complaints. Accounting records are archived for 10 years as required by law. Photos and Creative Sheet content are deleted once the order is completed, and no later than 90 days after the order is delivered.

s5.title: 5. Recipients and Data Transfers
s5.content:
We do not sell or provide your personal data to third parties for their marketing purposes. We only share data with processors strictly necessary for operation of the e-shop:

• Shipping companies (delivery of shipments).
• Stripe, Inc. (payment processing).
• Supabase, Inc. (cloud database and storage).
• Vercel, Inc. (application hosting).

All processors are bound by contractual data protection obligations in accordance with the GDPR.

s6.title: 6. Your Rights
s6.content:
You have the right to access your personal data, to have it corrected, erased ("right to be forgotten"), and to restrict its processing or request data portability. You also have the right to object to processing and to lodge a complaint with the Office for Personal Data Protection (www.uoou.cz).

Send requests to exercise your rights by e-mail to info@mycreativestamp.com. We will respond within 30 days.

s7.title: 7. Cookies
s7.content: This website uses technical cookies necessary for the application to function (login, cart, editor). We also use analytics and marketing cookies to help us understand customer behavior on the e-shop.

s8.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
s8.content:
This policy may be updated from time to time. We will notify you by e-mail of any material changes. The current version is always available on this page.

Valid from 1 January 2025.
